summary: Senior full stack engineer, 12 years, JavaScript and TypeScript at the core: Node.js backends, React 19 and Vue 3 frontends, GraphQL end to end (authored GraphQL server and client libraries). I run production on self-hosted Kubernetes with real observability: Prometheus metrics, Sentry error tracking, logs and tracing, incident triage as the solo on-call for a live game serving 1,300+ users. Distributed systems background from Bitfinex exchange pipelines, where monitoring and troubleshooting under pressure was the job. Based in Da Nang, Vietnam.

bullets: Operate a ~600K-line platform end to end: Node.js/Bun services, React 19 frontend, GraphQL APIs, Redis 8, custom Rust indexer — full monitoring with Prometheus and Sentry (metrics, logs, error tracing).
Solo on-call for a live Java 25 game backend (1,300+ users): incident triage, root cause analysis of distributed-systems failures, capacity and reliability on self-hosted Kubernetes.
Authored 18+ open-source npm libraries including GraphQL servers/clients and WebSocket tooling (HydreIO org).
Engineered an agentic development harness (Claude Code multi-agent + mechanical gates) enforcing code review and testing discipline.
Owned end-to-end blockchain integrations for production deposit and withdrawal pipelines at a top-tier crypto exchange (Node.js, TypeScript).
Integrated multiple L1/L2 chain backends into the exchange — including the Sui listing — and maintained them under production load.
Owned chain-specific edge cases — reorgs, finality thresholds, fee accounting — where a bug loses customer funds.
Shipped React + Node.js microservices for self-sovereign identity and credential verification — REST APIs, Docker, AWS.
Delivered across distributed teams spanning EU, Singapore, and India.
Led a 4-engineer team building a real-estate platform from zero to production; owned architecture, infrastructure, and hiring.
Created and maintain 18+ open-source npm libraries (auth, real-time graphs, transport, storage) — github.com/HydreIO.
